header.name: PracticeCrystalSimBot BP
header.description: Crystal PvP practice bot as SimulatedPlayer. Requires Beta APIs experiment ON. v0.9.2: Freeze fix - removing one bot mid-fight no longer stops the remaining bot (per-bot exception isolation, instant stale-target invalidation, cache cleanup on entity removal, idle look-around when no target). Bot debug/persistent logs are now mirrored to the content log so they can be read/copied in the log viewer. v0.9.1: Hard preset enables built-in debug logging by default (enabled/movement/combat/health). v0.9.0: 1) Strict Elytra-Mace discipline (never flies when enemy holds/uses crystals or anchors, never flies underground/indoors, requires >=14 horizontal blocks, aborts dive immediately if enemy starts crystal combat); 2) Held-item & action synchronization (prevents sword/obsidian overwrite during crystal/anchor/ranged/mace sequences, swaps active item into hotbar & syncs selectedSlotIndex); 3) Smart 1-block front blast mitigation (reuses existing cover blocks instead of re-placing every time, strictly 1-block feet-level cover with no 2-high walls so movement stays wide open).
